hook: Bank gold for a quiet winter, then blow it all in one loud summer turn: every saved coin pays twice.
loop: Split your gold: spending fires Spree, saving fires Thrift.
Hive units grow on saved gold; Carnival units grow on spending.
Blow the saved pile in one turn for a burst of Sprees.

growth.line: Every 3 gold saved or spent triggers growth; a 30-gold summer turn gives Carnival units +10/+10.

feel.early: Carnival climbs early; Hive saves gold and loses fights.
feel.mid: Bank grows; Ottavia and Tettix in hand build toward summer.
feel.late: One 30-gold summer turn; Gravelle sprays, Clemenza pays both towns.

stars.why: Grows in hand while you save, then buffs Carnival per Spree.
Sell him, he returns to the shop bigger: a Spree pump.
Its Shell Mask lets a unit wear another town's trigger.

card_short.u02: Carnival. In fight, Attack per Spree, Health per saved gold.
card_short.u03: Hive. Thrift: gains Health; sells for gold per 5 Health.
card_short.u04: Hive. Thrift: buffs the front-row units in front of it.
card_short.u05: Carnival. Spree: permanently buffs another random unit.
card_short.u06: Road. Start of Turn: gold, more next to each town.
card_short.u07: Hive. Sold, returns to your shop frozen and bigger.
card_short.u08: Carnival. Sold: Shell Mask copying its left neighbour's triggers.
card_short.u09: Road. Spree buffs random Hive; Thrift buffs random Carnival.
card_short.u10: Hive. Thrift: grows and freezes your shop's leftmost unit.
card_short.u11: Hive. Start of Turn: interest, 1 gold per 5 held.
card_short.u12: Carnival. Start of Combat: other Carnival units gain per Spree.
card_short.u13: Carnival. End of Turn near broke: every Spree fires again.
card_short.u14: Carnival. Spree buffs other Carnival units; grows while in hand.
card_short.u15: Hive. Your other units' Thrifts trigger twice.
card_short.u16: Hive. Start of Combat: sprays all enemies by gold held.
card_short.u17: Hive. Can't attack. Thrift: adds a Hive copy to hand.
card_short.u18: Carnival. Sprees every 2 gold; Spree buffs all other units.
card_short.u19: Road. Spent gold feeds Thrift; saved gold fires Spree units.
card_short.x01: Item. A unit gains another's Spree and Thrift lines.

builds.name: Summer
builds.line: Spend to 0 every turn; cycle Fennimore, end with Cigale.

builds.name: Winter
builds.line: Bank 12-15 gold; Banker interest, Gravelle sprays, Messor and Melissa.

builds.name: The Long Wait
builds.line: Save two or three turns, then one 30-gold turn of Sprees.

liked: Tettix growing in hand, then leading the summer turn: the tribe in one card.
Paying for gold both saved and spent plays unlike any other tribe.
worries: Watch: Mother Melissa with Messor and Clemenza could chain copies into triples.
Watch: Tettix Shell Masks with Penniless Tenor, and Fennimore with Cigale, grow steeply.
changed: Every card now prints its town: Hive, Carnival or Road.
Shell Masks, Ottavia's freeze and Clemenza reworded to read at a glance.
Busker pays on saving turns; Tenor tolerates one coin; no empty Masks.
verdict: Anyone who loves planning one huge spike turn: save quietly through winter, then spend everything in summer.
